looks.label: Torchlit flicker on the underground plane
looks.technique: Each frame, when the player is on plane index 3 and the flicker option is on, the scene light is reset with a small random jitter on ambient and diffuse values. Reads as unstable torch light with no new art.
looks.ref: src/mudclient.c lines 4718-4724; option default at src/options.c line 90

looks.label: Cycling sprite frames for fire, lightning and spell-charge objects
looks.technique: A global counter steps three, four and five state cycles. Each object whose id matches a fire, lightning, fire-spell or spell-charge id gets its numbered animation frame swapped in when the cycle changes.

looks.label: Fog-of-war veil with a distance-driven fog plane
looks.technique: Fog distance is set from the camera clip range, pulled in when fog-of-war is on and pushed out when it is off. Fog-of-war toggles with camera zoom state. Gives a soft veil around the player without per-object effects.

originals.name: Torch Depths
originals.idea: Underground floors get a light that breathes: a slow random wobble on the ambient level, with a faint warm shift on the diffuse level. Mood only, no new models.
originals.keep: A per-floor light override that jitters each frame on the lowest floor.
originals.change: Our own palette and rhythm (a slow pulse, not a random flicker); tie the pulse to a single torch or crystal source.

originals.name: Veil of Mist
originals.idea: Fog-of-war as a player-toggled veil: near the player the fog thins, and far terrain drops into haze when the veil is on.
originals.keep: A toggle that changes only the fog distance, so it costs almost nothing at runtime.
originals.change: Veil shape (a round reveal around the hero, not the camera plane); add a short fade when the toggle flips.
